title: Yellow Crisp Brazilian Masarepa Fry
description: A winey and crisp post-workout Brazilian dish featuring yellow masarepa, perfect for a robata grill.
instructions: Heat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
In a mixing bowl, combine the yellow masarepa and water, stirring until it forms a thick batter.
Heat the coconut oil in a small pan over medium heat, then add the diced onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and chopped spicy malagueta pepper to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the cilantro to the pan and stir for 30 seconds.
Using a spatula, spread the masarepa batter onto the grill in a circular shape, about 1/4 inch thick.
Cook the masarepa for 2 minutes, until the edges start to brown.
Flip the masarepa and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the masarepa from the grill and top with crumbled feta cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve immediately.
